map.英语词汇：随机出隐藏英文单词，按字母逐步猜，练拼写与词汇量。: English vocabulary: hidden English words are drawn at random and guessed letter by letter, practising spelling and vocabulary.
map.休闲挑战：限制错误次数，记录胜率与最少步数。: Casual challenge: limit the number of errors and track win rate and minimum moves.
map.课堂活动：老师选词库难度，学生轮流猜。: Classroom activity: the teacher picks the lexicon difficulty and students take turns guessing.
map.内置以英文单词为主；中文猜词建议用其他字词类工具: The built-in lexicon is mainly English words; for Chinese word guessing use another word-based tool
